text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
レダ様ですね？　お話は伺っています。
あなたの大剣闘祭の参加を受理しました。
text.official_en:
Leda, right? I know of you. You've been accepted as
an entrant in the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まもなく開会宣言が始まります。
どうぞ、闘技場の中へお入りください。
text.official_en:
The opening announcements will begin soon.
Please, make your way to the stands.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
さて……レヒネルが動くのは新月の直前だ。
<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
Lechner will make his move shortly before the new
moon. We should make ours on <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今日はまさに新月の直前だ。
レヒネルが動く……こちらも動くとしようか。
text.official_en:
The new moon is tomorrow, which means Lechner's
setting out. We should too.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それがしも、かつてダグシオンに居た頃は
千人隊長の役目を授かっておりました。
text.official_en:
During my time in Dagsion I rose to the level of
pilus prior.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
キジェルモ様がシドニア総督に命じられた際に、
その地位を捨て、ついて行くことにしたのです。
text.official_en:
But when Lord Guillermo was appointed the viceroy
of Cydonia, I gave up my role and went with him.
text.real_en:
But when Lord Quijermo was appointed the viceroy
of Cydonia, I gave up my role and went with him.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
久しぶりに訪れたが、ダグシオンを吹き抜ける
都会の風もまた、良いものだ。
text.official_en:
It's been a while since I visited, but the breeze that
blows through Dagsion's streets is as lovely as ever.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さて、今宵はどのような美女と過ごすか……
あとで街へ繰り出し、目星でも付けておくか。
text.official_en:
Now, to find a beauty to share my bed with. I'd best
head into town and scout one out!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
見たこと無いくらい立派な街……
本当にダグシオンに着いちゃったの？
text.official_en:
I've never seen such a dazzling city. We really just
poofed ourselves into Dagsion?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こんな事が出来ちゃうなんて、
神様って、やっぱりすごいんだなあ……
text.official_en:
The gods must really be great, if they can do things
like that!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
都会はいいですわよね。なんといっても
不快な虫をあまり見かけませんもの。
text.official_en:
How I adore the city! Not least thanks to the lack
of unpleasant insects...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そういえば、あたくしがダグシオンを
訪れるなど、いったいいつ以来だったかしら。
text.official_en:
You know, I can't recall how long it's been since I
last visited Dagsion.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
………………かつてこの
ダグシオンを後にした時――
text.official_en: When I left Dagsion, I made a vow.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それがしは自らの生命をかけてキジェルモ様を
お守りする誓いを立てたものでした。
text.official_en: I would protect Lord Guillermo with my life.
text.real_en: I would protect Lord Quijermo with my life.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
なのに、それを違え、
それがしは生き延びてしまいました。
text.official_en:
In spite of that oath, it is I who survived, while he
was killed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………いや、今のそれがしには、
姫をお守りするという重大な使命がござります。
text.official_en:
But it's alright, milady. Now my utmost duty is
protecting you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この年老いた命に替えても、
この使命だけは、果たさせていただく所存です。
text.official_en:
I will do that at the cost of my life—for whatever
this faded life is worth.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえばレダ嬢、貴女は
ダグシオンに来たのは初めてかね？
text.official_en: Miss Leda, is this your first time in Dagsion?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしよければ、おれがこの街の
各地を案内してやることも可能だが……
text.official_en: I'd be delighted to give you a tour, should you desire.

text.jp: <NCA>頼もうかしら
text.official_en: <NCA>Tell him you'll consider it.

text.jp: <NCB>大きなお世話
text.official_en: <NCB>Tell him to lay off.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACA>ああ、喜んでお付き合いしよう。
劇場でも、酒場でも、港でも。
text.official_en:
<ACA>Good! I can accompany you to the theater,
the tavern, the port...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACA>なんなら恋人たちが愛を囁き合う
秘密の花園でも……
text.official_en:
<ACA>or the secret garden where lovers impart to each
other sweet nothings.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
<ACA>おや、レダ嬢、何故そんな目で
おれのことを見るのかね？
text.official_en: <ACA>Why are you looking at me like that?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACB>ほう、不要かね？　
相変わらずレダ嬢は守りが堅い。
text.official_en:
<ACB>So you don't need one? I see your walls are sturdy
as ever.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>……しかし、毎度そのように袖にされると
おれとしても流石に、こたえるものがあるな。
text.official_en:
<ACB>You know, even on a man like me, ceaseless
rejection takes its toll.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ともあれ、<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: Anyway, if you're of the mind to head to the <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こことは少々雰囲気が異なる場所だが……
レダ嬢ならば、慣れたものだろう。
text.official_en:
Compared to up here, it's a much different
atmosphere...but one you're likely accustomed to.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の開会式、すごかったな……
あんな何万人もの人が一箇所に集まるなんて……
text.official_en:
That opening ceremony was INCREDIBLE! Tens of
thousands of people in one spot?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ほんとうにびっくりしちゃったよ。
どこを向いても人、人、人なんだもん。
text.official_en:
I mean, wow! No matter where I looked, there were
people, and people, and more people!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それにしても、ここがいくら都会だからって、
一体どこにあれだけの人が隠れていたんだろう。
text.official_en:
I know this is a big city, but seriously. Where do they
fit them all?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さすが、大都会に暮らす者は、どこか
洗練された雰囲気をまとっている気もしますわね。
text.official_en:
As one would expect in a major metropolis like this,
the place abounds with sophisticates!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そうですわ。あとで市場に顔を出して、
最近の帝都の流行を押さえておかなくては。
text.official_en:
Yes—I simply must pop by the market later and
glean what I can of the capital's latest trends.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
面白いものがあれば、カーラ様の
お耳にも入れて差し上げましょう。
text.official_en:
Anything interesting I learn, I'll bring it to Kalla's
attention, tout de suite.
text.real_en:
Anything interesting I learn, I'll bring it to Cara's
attention, tout de suite.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大剣闘祭までに、レヒネルのほうを
片付けてしまいたいところです。
text.official_en:
I'd prefer to handle our business with Lechner
before the Heroic Games begin.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……あの男は、それがしも
許すことなど出来ませぬ。
text.official_en: Like you, I find that man's actions deplorable.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの男さえ居なければ、キジェルモ様も
命を落とさずに済んだかもしれないと思うと……
text.official_en:
If not for him, Lord Guillermo may not have lost his
life that day.
text.real_en:
If not for him, Lord Quijermo may not have lost his
life that day.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
試合の当日まで期間があるようならば、
無為に過ごすのは勿体ないというものだ。
text.official_en:
We have some time before the day of the match,
and I'd suggest we not spend it idly.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
幸いといってはなんだが、
この街には悩みを抱えるものも多い。
text.official_en:
There are many in this city in need of help,
fortunately for us—if not for them.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういった者達からの依頼をこなしていけば、
いろいろと得られるものが有りそうに思うがね。
text.official_en:
We may have something to gain by fulfilling
their requests.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
レダさん、ボク思ったんだけど、
闘技場の中に入ることができれば、
text.official_en:
Leda, I had a thought. What if we got inside the
arena somehow?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大闘技場に所属している剣闘士たちと
お話くらいは出来るかもしれないよね。
text.official_en:
We might be able to talk with gladiators connected
to the Heroic Games!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あ、でも、よく考えてみたら
ボクたちってお尋ね者だから……
text.official_en: On second thought...we are wanted criminals.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そんな、神殿の役人とか兵士が多そうな所に
普段から近づかないほうがよさそうだね。
text.official_en:
Maybe it's not the best idea to barge into places full
of temple officials and soldiers.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それにしてもそのレヒネルという男、
あたくしもただでは済ませませんわ。
text.official_en:
I am no more inclined than you to let this Lechner
man get away with what he's done.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
うら若いレイリダーナの心をもてあそび、
あまつさえ深い傷を残すなんて。
text.official_en:
To play with young Leilidahna's heart and leave her
with such a deep wound! Hmph.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
神殿にいた頃の、純粋だったあなたの姿を
よく覚えているだけに、いっそう許せませんわ。
text.official_en:
It's all the more loathsome when I recall how pure
and innocent you were at the temple.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
レイリダーナよ、息災か？
問題なく過ごせているなら何よりだが。
text.official_en:
Leilidahna, are you well? I am relieved to hear you
aren't having any problems.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
改めて伝える必要もないかもしれんが、
大剣闘祭は強者たちが一堂に会する場。
text.official_en:
I'm sure I don't need to remind you that the Heroic
Games are a gathering of the mightiest warriors.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
其方の目的を達するためには、
より技を洗練させる必要があるだろう。
text.official_en:
You will need to refine your skills if you wish to
achieve your goal.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
仲間たちとともに励むが良い、
それが、其方の道を開くことになるだろう。
text.official_en:
Only if you and your allies make every effort shall the
path open before you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
まもなく神威法王より、
ダグシオン大剣闘祭の開会宣言が行われます。
text.official_en:
The Divine Sovereign is about to announce the
opening of the Heroic Games.

text.jp:
大闘技場に向かうのならば、
この参道の階段を下ればすぐですよ。
text.official_en:
If you are headed to the arena, simply head down
the stairs and follow this path.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
大剣闘祭に優勝したら、神威法王が
何でも願いを聞いてくれるんだって？
text.official_en:
I heard that, whoever wins, the Divine Sovereign will
grant any wish they want?

text.jp:
それなら俺も、参加申し込みくらいは
しといてもよかったかな……？
text.official_en: Darn. Maybe I should have entered.

text.jp:
やめとけよ。お前程度の腕前じゃ、
予選も通過できやしないぜ。
text.official_en:
Sure. Except that you're so lousy with a weapon,
you'd be out in the qualifiers.

text.jp:
なんてったって、大剣闘祭には
ダグザ中から凄腕の連中が参加するんだから。
text.official_en:
Remember, the Heroic Games have the best fighters
from all over Dagda competing.
